items.stem: Which TWO practices reflect responsible use of Copilot suggestions? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Review and test generated code before merging
options.rationale: Correct: the outline stresses validating AI output.

options.text: Accept suggestions that compile without reading them
options.rationale: Compiling does not prove correctness or security.

options.text: Check suggestions for security issues such as injection
options.rationale: Correct: suggesting and checking security improvements is in scope.

options.text: Disable code review because Copilot wrote the code
options.rationale: AI-generated code still needs human review.
